messages:
Diego (acme-cs): Hey team — our production tenants hitting p99 latency ~4-6s on embeddings endpoint since 11:10 UTC, started after a token rotation. Getting increased 5xx/429 and lots of queued requests. sample req: abc123-def456. Can you triage?
Maya (support): Sorry Diego — filing internal triage here, @Jared @Priya can you take a look? Any quick mitigations? :eyes:
Jared (eng-runtime): On it. Diego — can you paste a curl + headers you used? Also which model variant and tenant id?
Diego (acme-cs): tenant=acme-prod, model=small-embed-v2, curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`
Diego (acme-cs): Log snippet we captured: ```2026-03-17T11:12:33Z ERROR auth-validate time=512ms req=abc123-def456 tenant=acme-prod endpoint=/v1/embeddings
2026-03-17T11:12:33Z WARN queue wait=220ms inflight=96 queue_size=312
2026-03-17T11:12:34Z ERROR router timeout=1200ms req=abc124 tenant=acme-prod
```
Maya (support): Noted. Patterns: auth validation high latency + queue growth. Could be sync auth path adding CPU latency and causing workers to pile up.
Priya (eng-sre): Seeing correlated alerts for auth-validator pod restarts and an uptick in tail latency for token introspection. Hypothesis: token rotation triggered cache misses and synchronous KMS/HSM calls.
Jared (eng-runtime): Confirmed from metrics: auth-validator miss rate jumped ~90% at 11:09, avg validation latency from 6ms->480ms. That extra ~480ms multiplied by concurrency is causing admission queueing and p99 blowup.
Maya (support): What's a safe quick mitigation we can ship while eng teams investigate? Customer needs p99 under 1s.
Priya (eng-sre): Short term: 1) temporarily increase per-tenant concurrency limit for acme-prod from 20->50 (reduces queueing). 2) enable fallback routing to small-embed-v1 (lighter) for acme-prod. 3) restart auth-validator pods after warming cache with rotated tokens.
Jared (eng-runtime): I can flip a per-tenant override and enable model fallback. Doing that now — will monitor. @deploy-bot can we restart auth-validator cluster with rolling restart but keep warmup windows?
deploy-bot: Scheduled rolling restart for svc/auth-validator in prod starting in 2 minutes. Canary on 2 pods, then rollout.
Jared (eng-runtime): Per-tenant concurrency updated for acme-prod -> 50. Fallback route enabled to small-embed-v1 for requests over 1500ms backend.
Maya (support): Diego — can you confirm if you see immediate improvement?
Diego (acme-cs): After the changes p95 ~600ms, p99 down to ~1.2s, errors reduced. Still some spikes but much better. Thanks.
Priya (eng-sre): Next steps: 1) root cause: token rotation caused auth cache misses + synchronous KMS calls — we need async validation + local cache fallback. 2) add a short-lived in-memory token cache in auth-validator to survive rotation storms. 3) adjust admission controller to react to auth-validation latency signals.
Jared (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a hotfix: make auth check path nonblocking (return soft-allow + background validation for warmup) and add a metric export for validation-miss-rate. Planning PR and QA canary.
Maya (support): I'll keep Diego updated and create a ticket with mitigation timeline and RCA. Incident ticket: INC-2026-1523.
Diego (acme-cs): Appreciated. Can you add a short repro doc for us? We captured headers and a small script.
Jared (eng-runtime): Repro steps I posted in incident ticket: 1) rotate token for a tenant; 2) flood embeddings endpoint with ~100 concurrent requests for 60s; 3) observe auth-validator miss-rate and queue growth. Attachments: curl script + `kubectl logs` snippet.
Priya (eng-sre): Also recommending we protect critical endpoints by prioritizing traffic for tenants that opt into fast-path auth. Add to roadmap.
Maya (support): Marking this thread resolved for now since customer saw improvement. Will reopen if p99 >1.5s in next 24h. :white_check_mark:
